name: Deploy react_vite

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
      - name: setup node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: npm
      
      - name: install dependencies
        run: npm install
      
      - name: run lint
        run: npm run lint
  
  build:
    needs: lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: npm
      - run: npm install
      - run: npm run build
      - run: ls -la dist
